integration_policy: Integrate the evidence/docs semantically onto the current authority; do not treat this campaign as fresh acceptance evidence for 00b678aa or descendants.

known_measurement_limits.detail: The requested smaller sampled thinking comparison specified temperature=0.9 with seed omitted. The frozen harness/results use thinking_off_t09_s42 and thinking_on_t09_s42 with seed=42. Preserve these results as fixed-seed characterization; they do not satisfy the requested seed-omitted sampling cell.

protocol_attempt() inspects assistant content/reasoning exposed by the parsed OpenAI response, not a raw backend token stream. parser_recognition_conditional_on_attempted_call therefore applies only to API-visible protocol attempts and cannot exclude parser-consumed or suppressed malformed attempts.

invented_values() primarily detects ungrounded SHA/SHA256-shaped values, supplemented by per-case forbidden values. The aggregate ungrounded_hallucination_rate is not a complete detector for arbitrary invented non-hash fields.

For allow_no_tool cases with empty expected fields, an emitted intended tool call with empty arguments can classify PASS when it uses no forbidden/hash value. These cases therefore do not fully enforce the intended no-call-on-nonmapping contract.

Campaign A does not unconditionally reject len(tool_calls) != 1; an intended first call plus extra calls can evade the multiplicity check. No claim about exact-one-call reliability should be inferred without inspecting the affected trials.

Wilson intervals over repeated fixed-seed cells describe observed repeated-run stability. They should not be presented as confidence intervals over independent stochastic model draws without an independence justification.

The campaign records production_sha and binary_sha256, but the harness does not independently derive the binary source SHA from the executable. Treat source-to-binary binding as recorded provenance unless corroborated by an external version/build stamp.

accepted_claim_scope: The frozen campaign contains 316 recorded trials attributable in its provenance to production SHA 908bc8b7e3bdd24ddd5eb9b27bbe15bcffb00703 and binary SHA256 83938cf36ef70a53e024e467f31b4a8b841e66815b93292457ae1b1472bd105b.
Named and required cells in this historical campaign report 30/30 and 50/50 PASS respectively.
The campaign is useful evidence for grounded-value failure modes and auto/tool-choice characterization subject to the measurement limits above.
